description:
🚀 Welcome to our team for the "Abandoned but Not Forgotten" challenge! We are a Universal Event team aiming to create an innovative, interactive tool to discover, map, and breathe new life into forgotten or decommissioned space artifacts and historical NASA data. 

Whether you love frontend development, backend engineering, data science, or creative UI/UX design and storytelling, we need you! Let's combine our skills to preserve space history. Join us and let's build something epic!
